scenes: In twenty ten, a website gave away free bitcoin.
Today, those coins are worth over a billion dollars.
All you had to do was solve a cap-cha.
It was called the Bitcoin Faucet.
A programmer named Gavin Andreesen built it.
He filled it with eleven hundred of his own coins.
Even Satoshi Nakamoto replied, with tips to stop cheaters.
Back then, five bitcoin were worth less than a dollar.
In total, it gave away about nineteen thousand seven hundred bitcoin.
Today, that is over one point four billion dollars.
Those five free coins? Over three hundred sixty thousand dollars.
Why give it away? He wanted people to try it.
